_comment: Fleet client config for Google Data Agent Kit, FIRST COHORT ONLY (dak-bigquery, dak-gcs, dak-kc). Entries mirror the upstream plugin's mcp_config.json verbatim; paths resolve inside the installed plugin directory (install the plugin first - see docs/ops/DATA-AGENT-KIT-WIRING.md). Auth is ADC with impersonation of the read-only service account in ops/data_agent_kit/guardrail-policy.yaml - never the owner's user credentials, never a service-account key. The remaining kit servers are intentionally absent: the fleet has no data on them yet.
